title: Hoof Strike
description:
You lash out with one sharp blow of the hoof, your whole weight behind it.

You make an {{attaque}} ({{force}} + {{melee}}) with your hooves. On a success, the target takes {{1d4 degats-contondant}} and makes a {{sauvegarde}} ({{constitution}} + {{resistance}}) against your {{dd}} (10 + {{force}} + {{melee}}). On a failure, it is {{etourdi}} until the end of its next {{tour}}.
